reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

title.narrative: Reintegration of released women and their families into society (Bidayah)

description.narrative: - Skills-based training and provision of professional tools. - Community reintegration (psychological support, social support, and health support) for released women and their families. - Educational support for the children of released women (documentation support for children who have lost their IDs, school registration, supporting schools with educational tools, school bags, school uniforms, providing school books, offering extracurricular activities, and psychosocial support in schools). - Raising community awareness about gender-based violence.
40 released women and their families (338 individuals)
Enhancing the resilience of released women through economic recovery, psychosocial and health support, and their reintegration into society.
